Paperlark Support

Answers to common questions. Still stuck? Email SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD and a human will reply, usually within 2 business days. Please never send us your documents or ID numbers.

Scanning and documents

What's free, and what does Pro add?

Scanning, text recognition, search and export are free, with no watermark and no page limit. The free version shows ads and includes up to 3 folders and 1 saved signature. Paperlark Pro removes ads and unlocks extras such as unlimited folders and signatures, smart redaction and receipt exports. The Pro screen in the app lists everything included.

Text wasn't recognized correctly. What can I do?

Text recognition runs on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework. It works best with flat pages, good even light and the whole page in the frame. Rescan the page or retake it from the document's page grid. Handwriting and unusual fonts may not be recognized perfectly, so check important numbers yourself.

Does the AI summary send my document anywhere?

No. Summaries and "ask this document" run entirely on your iPhone, using Apple's on-device Foundation Models on iOS 26 devices with Apple Intelligence, and a simpler key-sentence method on other devices. They work in Airplane Mode. Nothing is uploaded to us or to any AI service. Summaries can miss things, so check the original for anything important.

How do I open a PDF from Mail or Files in Paperlark?

Tap the PDF or image, tap the share button and choose Paperlark. Paperlark makes its own copy, so you can sign, redact or file it without changing the original.

How does redaction work? Is it safe?

Smart redaction finds emails, phone numbers, addresses, card numbers, account numbers, Social Security numbers and dates, and you can add or remove boxes by hand. When you share the safe copy, the black boxes are burned into the page images and the hidden text is removed from the PDF's text layer, so it can't be uncovered or copied. Detection is automatic and can miss things, so always check the preview before you share. Your original document is kept unchanged in Paperlark.

Can I password-protect a PDF?

Yes. Choose a password when you export. Paperlark uses Apple's standard PDF encryption. We can't recover a forgotten PDF password, so store it somewhere safe.

Are my saved signatures private?

Yes. Signatures and initials you save are stored as drawings in Paperlark's private database on your iPhone. They are never uploaded and never shared with ad partners. Delete a saved signature from the signature library at any time.

Your data and privacy

Where are my documents stored? Can the developer see them?

On your iPhone, in Paperlark's private storage with iOS's strongest file protection. There is no account and no server of ours, so we can't see your documents. Ads in the free version never receive them. Full details: privacy policy.

Does Paperlark sync with iCloud? How do I move to a new iPhone?

This version doesn't sync between devices. Your documents move to a new iPhone with an iCloud Backup, a computer backup or Apple's Quick Start transfer. You can also export PDFs and save them to Files at any time.

Why do my documents show up in iPhone search? How do I stop it?

Paperlark adds each document's title, type and recognized text to the Spotlight index on your iPhone so you can find it from iPhone search. The index stays on your device. To turn it off, go to Paperlark Settings > Privacy and turn off Find documents in Spotlight; Paperlark removes its entries.

How do I lock Paperlark with Face ID?

Turn on the lock in Paperlark Settings. If Face ID doesn't work, iOS lets you use your iPhone passcode. Paperlark never receives your face data.

Can I hide document names on widgets?

Yes. Turn off Show titles on widgets in Paperlark Settings and widgets show "Document" instead of the title. Widgets never show page images or document text.

How do due-date reminders work?

When Paperlark finds a due date on a bill or form, you can turn on a reminder for that document. It arrives at 9:00 the day before the due date and is scheduled on your iPhone, not sent from a server. Check the due date yourself: automatically found dates can be wrong.

How do I delete my data?
  • One document: delete it from the library. Its files, Spotlight entries and reminders go with it.
  • Everything: Paperlark Settings > Delete everything wipes all documents, files, signatures, Spotlight entries and notifications. It can't be undone, so export anything you want to keep first.
  • Deleting the app also removes its data (but does not cancel a subscription). Copies you saved to Files or Photos stay where you put them.

Purchases and subscriptions

Paperlark Pro is available as a yearly subscription (with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime purchase that works with Family Sharing. Prices are shown in the app in your currency before you buy.

How do I restore my purchase?
  1. Make sure you are signed in to the App Store with the same Apple ID you used to buy Paperlark Pro (Settings > [your name] > Media & Purchases).
  2. Open Paperlark, go to Settings and tap Restore Purchases (it is also on the Pro screen).
  3. If you got Pro through Family Sharing, make sure Purchase Sharing is on for your family group.

Restoring needs an internet connection to reach the App Store. If it says nothing was found, email us with the approximate purchase date (never send card details); we can't see your Apple ID, but we can help you check.

How do I cancel my free trial or subscription?

Subscriptions are managed by Apple. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

  1. Open the iPhone Settings app.
  2. Tap your name, then Subscriptions.
  3. Tap Paperlark Pro, then Cancel Subscription (or Cancel Free Trial).

Or, inside Paperlark: Settings > Manage subscription opens the same Apple screen.

To avoid being charged after a free trial, cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. The app can send you a reminder 2 days before the trial ends if notifications are on. If you cancel during a trial, Apple may end Pro access right away. If you cancel a paid subscription, you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for. Apple's guide: Cancel a subscription from Apple.

How do I get a refund?

Apple processes every payment, so refunds come from Apple: go to reportaproblem.apple.com, sign in, choose "Request a refund" and pick the Paperlark purchase. We can't issue refunds directly, but email us if something went wrong and we'll do what we can.

I have a subscription. Can I switch to Lifetime?

Yes. Buy Lifetime in the app, then cancel the subscription in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions so it doesn't renew. The app reminds you to do this. Apple decides whether any unused subscription time is refunded.

Why do I see ads, and how do I turn them off?

The free version is funded by ads. Paperlark Pro (subscription or lifetime) removes all ads. To stop personalized ads without buying anything, choose "Ask App Not to Track" (or change it later in Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking) and review your choices in Paperlark Settings > Ad Privacy Choices. Details are in the privacy policy.
